Thus long waterside LEFT->FRONT=(800,400), short FRONT->RIGHT=(400,-200), ratio exactly 2.0. Thin slab vertical thickness 22 pixels, not a tall plinth. Keep the rear edge BACK->RIGHT straight and unobstructed for fitting into a riverbank; no rocks, vines, plants or props hanging over that edge. Clearly expose all four rectangle corners and both docking front edges. All stone slab joints follow those same +0.5/-0.5 ground axes. Upper-left light and short contact shadows only. TRUE transparent RGBA, fully opaque wharf, no water, no surrounding terrain, no aura, no background. Generous padding, entire object visible. No persons, boats, text, modern objects, grid or watermark. One asset.
